title: Design canon mirror
description: Structure binding for the machine-managed mirror of the frozen design canon under .vanguard/docs/design/. The store copy watches docs/designs/vanguard.md: when the canon changes, the mirror goes stale and must be re-synced and re-attested. Its H2 skeleton is pinned so a divergent mirror fails structure verification instead of silently drifting. Declared by frontmatter: schema: design-canon.
